cursor_behavior: Require SAML or OIDC SSO and disable local login where the plan permits it.
enterprise_setting: Verify supported IdP, enforcement scope, break-glass behavior, and domain claim in the admin console.
risk: Account takeover, orphaned access, or local-login bypass.
verification_method: Sign in with an assigned user and attempt a local-login bypass.
pass_criteria: Assigned users authenticate through the approved IdP and local bypass is blocked.

cursor_behavior: Provision and deprovision users and groups from the authoritative directory.
enterprise_setting: Verify group mapping, seat removal, token revocation, and plan availability in the contract and console.
risk: Account takeover, orphaned access, or local-login bypass.
verification_method: Create, update, suspend, and delete a test user through SCIM.
pass_criteria: Every lifecycle event reaches Cursor within the documented service window.

cursor_behavior: Keep emergency admin access limited, monitored, and tested.
enterprise_setting: Cursor's public pages do not define a universal break-glass workflow; verify available controls.
risk: Account takeover, orphaned access, or local-login bypass.
verification_method: Review named emergency accounts and run a documented access test.
pass_criteria: Emergency access has MFA, a named owner, an expiry or review date, and an audit trail.

cursor_behavior: Assign organization roles according to least privilege.
enterprise_setting: Verify the exact role catalog and permissions in the active workspace.
risk: Privilege creep or an unreviewed user gaining administrative scope.
verification_method: Export or review every privileged member and business justification.
pass_criteria: Each privileged account has a current owner and required responsibility.

cursor_behavior: Use identity groups and policies to isolate experimental users from production-facing teams.
enterprise_setting: Verify whether every required policy can be scoped by group.
risk: Privilege creep or an unreviewed user gaining administrative scope.
verification_method: Compare membership, repository scope, models, MCPs, and agent rules across groups.
pass_criteria: Pilot permissions cannot silently expand production access.

cursor_behavior: Enable and enforce Privacy Mode for all covered users.
enterprise_setting: Verify plan, workspace, account, and client-specific behavior in the console and agreement.
risk: Unapproved retention, training, provider, subprocessor, or residency exposure.
verification_method: Inspect the organization setting and test inheritance with a new member.
pass_criteria: New and existing members inherit the enforced setting.

cursor_behavior: Confirm that Privacy Mode excludes customer data from Cursor and model-provider training.
enterprise_setting: Required: public marketing alone is not sufficient for the buyer's legal requirement.
risk: Unapproved retention, training, provider, subprocessor, or residency exposure.
verification_method: Map the public claim to the signed DPA or MSA and active workspace setting.
pass_criteria: Contract language and console configuration support the same exclusion.

cursor_behavior: Confirm the zero-data-retention arrangement for every enabled provider and model.
enterprise_setting: Required: validate provider, model, region, abuse-monitoring exception, and change notification in contract or trust evidence.
risk: Unapproved retention, training, provider, subprocessor, or residency exposure.
verification_method: Request the provider matrix and compare it with the model allowlist.
pass_criteria: Each enabled model has a documented retention treatment and exception path.

cursor_behavior: Document retention for prompts, code context, indexes, logs, analytics, support records, and backups.
enterprise_setting: Unknown until the active agreement, plan, features, and support process are reviewed.
risk: Unapproved retention, training, provider, subprocessor, or residency exposure.
verification_method: Build a data-flow and retention table from contract, product settings, and trust evidence.
pass_criteria: Every data class has a duration, deletion path, and accountable owner.

cursor_behavior: Review Cursor and model-provider subprocessors before rollout and after changes.
enterprise_setting: Verify contract notice period and objection or termination rights.
risk: Unapproved retention, training, provider, subprocessor, or residency exposure.
verification_method: Download the current list, record purpose and location, and test change-notice handling.
pass_criteria: All material processors are approved or have a documented exception.

cursor_behavior: Map required regions to actual processing, storage, backup, and support locations.
enterprise_setting: Public pages do not establish a universal customer-selectable residency option; verify contractually.
risk: Unapproved retention, training, provider, subprocessor, or residency exposure.
verification_method: Compare architecture and subprocessor evidence with policy requirements.
pass_criteria: No unapproved region receives protected data.

cursor_behavior: Confirm TLS in transit and AES-256 at rest claims for covered services.
enterprise_setting: Verify feature scope, exclusions, key ownership, and availability of CMEK in the purchased plan.
risk: Protected code or prompts exposed without the required encryption boundary.
verification_method: Review trust evidence and, where available, configuration for customer-managed keys.
pass_criteria: Required data paths meet the organization's encryption standard.

cursor_behavior: Limit which repositories agents and users may access.
enterprise_setting: Verify whether policy is allowlist, blocklist, or both and which agent surfaces it covers.
risk: Sensitive repositories or files become available to an agent unexpectedly.
verification_method: Attempt access to one approved and one denied repository.
pass_criteria: Approved access works; denied access fails and is logged.

cursor_behavior: Use repository exclusions and product policy to keep secrets and restricted paths out of AI requests.
enterprise_setting: Cursor describes best-effort exclusions; verify residual risk and do not treat ignore files as a secret boundary.
risk: Sensitive repositories or files become available to an agent unexpectedly.
verification_method: Run a controlled test against denied paths and inspect client behavior.
pass_criteria: Restricted files are not intentionally included in prompts, indexes, or agent actions.

cursor_behavior: Allow only approved models and providers.
enterprise_setting: Verify new-model defaults, router behavior, provider retention, and change control.
risk: An unapproved model or provider receives company code or prompts.
verification_method: Compare the console allowlist with procurement and privacy approvals.
pass_criteria: Only reviewed models are selectable or routable.

cursor_behavior: Allow only reviewed MCP servers and remove stale connections.
enterprise_setting: Verify policy coverage for desktop, CLI, cloud agents, plugins, and user-defined servers.
risk: An unreviewed MCP server or credential can perform an external action.
verification_method: Attempt to connect an approved and an unapproved MCP server.
pass_criteria: Unapproved servers are blocked; approved servers have an owner and review date.

cursor_behavior: Issue scoped credentials per server and avoid long-lived shared secrets.
enterprise_setting: Verify where tokens are stored and which administrators or agents can reveal them.
risk: An unreviewed MCP server or credential can perform an external action.
verification_method: Inspect the credential store, scopes, rotation record, and revocation test.
pass_criteria: Credentials are least-privileged, non-exported where possible, rotated, and revocable.

cursor_behavior: Configure organization-wide agent policies before broad rollout.
enterprise_setting: Verify precedence, supported clients, sync timing, and exception workflow.
risk: Autonomous commands, network access, or prompt injection cross the approval boundary.
verification_method: Inspect required rules and test behavior with a new user.
pass_criteria: Mandatory rules apply to supported agent surfaces and cannot be silently bypassed.

control: Constrain auto-run, browser, and network access
cursor_behavior: Set conservative defaults for autonomous terminal, browser, and network actions.
enterprise_setting: Verify differences among local, CLI, background, and cloud agents.
risk: Autonomous commands, network access, or prompt injection cross the approval boundary.
verification_method: Run controlled allowed and denied actions in each supported agent surface.
pass_criteria: Denied actions require approval or fail; allowed actions are traceable.

cursor_behavior: Use restricted execution for agent terminal commands where supported.
enterprise_setting: Verify team-wide enforcement, bypass permissions, platform differences, and known exclusions.
risk: Autonomous commands, network access, or prompt injection cross the approval boundary.
verification_method: Test workspace boundaries, temporary-file access, network denial, and escape handling.
pass_criteria: The configured sandbox restricts the expected files and network paths.

cursor_behavior: Use managed hooks to observe or block sensitive agent actions.
enterprise_setting: Verify server-side distribution, tamper resistance, timeout behavior, and plan availability.
risk: Autonomous commands, network access, or prompt injection cross the approval boundary.
verification_method: Trigger before-prompt and before-command hooks with allowed and denied examples.
pass_criteria: Required hooks run, fail closed where intended, and generate reviewable evidence.

cursor_behavior: Exercise untrusted repository, web, issue, and MCP content against the approved configuration.
enterprise_setting: No public vendor page proves safety for the buyer's exact tools and data; validate locally.
risk: Autonomous commands, network access, or prompt injection cross the approval boundary.
verification_method: Run a documented adversarial test with canary secrets and denied tools.
pass_criteria: The agent does not exfiltrate canaries or cross the configured approval boundary.

cursor_behavior: Capture access, administrative, rule, and configuration events.
enterprise_setting: Verify event catalog, retention, API or export, latency, and plan limits.
risk: The organization cannot attribute, investigate, or prove a high-risk action.
verification_method: Change a test setting and confirm the event appears in dashboard and CSV export.
pass_criteria: Event identity, timestamp, action, target, and outcome are available for the required period.

cursor_behavior: Review adoption, usage, and AI-code metrics without over-collecting employee data.
enterprise_setting: Verify exact fields and legal basis before enabling broad reporting.
risk: The organization cannot attribute, investigate, or prove a high-risk action.
verification_method: Inventory dashboard fields, API outputs, recipients, and retention.
pass_criteria: Metrics have a declared purpose, access control, retention period, and employee notice where required.

cursor_behavior: Route available audit evidence into the organization's monitoring and incident workflow.
enterprise_setting: Verify supported export or API paths and compensate for unavailable events.
risk: The organization cannot attribute, investigate, or prove a high-risk action.
verification_method: Generate a high-risk test event and trace it from Cursor to the response queue.
pass_criteria: The event is ingested, enriched, assigned, and retained under policy.

cursor_behavior: Request current SOC 2 Type II and penetration-test materials from the trust portal.
enterprise_setting: Required: verify report coverage and bridge letters; certification is not a universal guarantee.
risk: Contractual or control gaps remain invisible until an incident or assessment.
verification_method: Record report period, exceptions, complementary controls, and remediation commitments.
pass_criteria: Evidence is current and gaps are accepted by accountable owners.

cursor_behavior: Set contractual notification, cooperation, evidence-preservation, and post-incident obligations.
enterprise_setting: Public pages do not define every customer's binding incident terms; verify the MSA or DPA.
risk: Contractual or control gaps remain invisible until an incident or assessment.
verification_method: Map the signed agreement to the incident response plan and contacts.
pass_criteria: Timeframes and responsibilities meet organizational requirements.

cursor_behavior: Validate account, workspace, index, token, automation, and retained-data cleanup.
enterprise_setting: Verify backups, legal holds, logs, shared artifacts, and contract termination handling.
risk: Stale access, data, or configuration survives offboarding or a material change.
verification_method: Offboard a test user and submit a deletion request; record each completion.
pass_criteria: Access is revoked promptly and deletion follows the documented schedule.

control: Monitor material product and policy changes
cursor_behavior: Track changes to models, subprocessors, retention, security features, and acquisition status.
enterprise_setting: Verify notification channels and contractual change rights.
risk: Stale access, data, or configuration survives offboarding or a material change.
verification_method: Review vendor notices monthly and compare them with the approved baseline.
pass_criteria: Material changes create a documented reassessment before policy expansion.

control: Maintain an exit and portability plan
cursor_behavior: Keep repository instructions, workflows, evidence, and critical automations portable to another agent.
enterprise_setting: Verify export availability, data return, deletion, license termination, and dependency inventory.
risk: Stale access, data, or configuration survives offboarding or a material change.
verification_method: Run an annual migration exercise on a representative repository.
pass_criteria: The team can revoke Cursor access and continue critical work within the recovery objective.
